scope: Explicit interface contract for the revised executor; matching labels are not a proof of semantic correctness.

relations.name: Round-trip fidelity
applicability: selected carrier and key are supported
relations.observer_boundary: declared trace and/or selected host and payload observations
relations.predicate: The extracted bytes equal p exactly.
relations.exposure_rule: INCONSISTENT only; no failed admission or infrastructure error is an exposure
